name: Hijiki
description: Black shredded seaweed rehydrated and simmered with soy and carrot.

ayurveda.note: Outside the classical record; read with kelp and nori.

unani.note: Outside the classical record; placed with the seaweeds.

histamine.note: Dried sea vegetable. It also carries inorganic arsenic, which is a separate and real caution.
